files_changed.summary: Added PointID (points.id), following the existing strong-ID-type convention.
Temperature (float64-based VO) + NewTemperature enforcing [0,1], mirroring point_conclusions.temperature's CHECK constraint in Go.
Point struct (id, run_id, parent_point_id, content, position) + NewPoint enforcing non-empty content and no self-parent; IsRoot() helper.
Table-driven: lower/upper bound, mid-range, below/above range.
Root point, child point, empty content rejected, self-parent rejected.

decisions: Skipped render-mode/rendering.go value types (confirmed with user): nothing in this task or the existing codebase consumes run_renderings yet — deferred to the future task that actually implements rendering.go.
Skipped point_conclusions/Conclusion entity (confidence_label, open_question, conclusion text) — not in this task's stated focus (Temperature, Point, score-range validation, parent/child shape).

No tree-assembly/cycle-detection helpers across multiple points — would require a loaded point set (repository/service layer), out of scope for a pure single-value-object task; Point only guards against the local self-parent case.
Temperature and Point follow the existing lightweight VO style from tasks 006/007 (plain defined types / structs + constructor validation, no opaque wrapper), for consistency.
